item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Harsh aiming a concave mirror at the Sun so parallel sunlight rays meet on a dry leaf held near the focus.

Why can a bright hot spot form on the leaf?

options.A: The concave mirror concentrates the reflected sunlight into a small spot on the leaf.
options.B: The concave mirror spreads the parallel rays evenly across the leaf, so no small hot spot is needed.
options.C: Any shiny object concentrates sunlight the same way even if its surface is flat.
options.D: The bright spot forms only because the leaf looks darker than the mirror in the diagram.
